_note: Research file (not read by pages, except the source link on the practice-set page): the structure of the exams our own practice sets follow, checked by scripts/check-pruefungen.mjs (same modules, same parts, same number of scored items per part). Ids are storage keys and stay: goethe-* = CILS (A2, B1, B2), telc-* = CELI (A2, B1). Sets for CILS C1, CELI B2 and CELI C1 were removed by exams-cils-celi (see reports/exams-cils-celi.md for the restore command). PLIDA and CERT.IT are added by exams-plida-certit. Only structure is described; no exam task or text is copied. Field conventions: minutes = paper time in OUR set; items = scored items in OUR set; plays = how often the recording is heard. Every figure about the real exams is 'to verify'.
